BotCleaner.title: Find suspicious Klaviyo profiles before they inflate your contact count.
BotCleaner.subtitle: Connect Klaviyo with OAuth, scan existing profiles, understand why they are flagged, and suppress selected profiles after your review.
BotCleaner.note: Guided setup with no theme-code changes. The current version does not require a private API key.
BotCleaner.probTitle: A clearer path from profile clutter to controlled action.
BotCleaner.probDesc: Bot Cleaner helps merchants audit profiles already in Klaviyo. Signals provide context, while the merchant decides what to do.
BotCleaner.probBox1Desc: Bot or fake signups can remain in a Klaviyo account and make contact data harder to review.
BotCleaner.probBox2Desc: A suspicious email pattern is a signal, not proof. Merchants should review the reasons before taking action.
BotCleaner.probBox3Desc: Reviewing profiles one by one can take time, especially after a signup burst.
BotCleaner.probBox4Desc: Bot Cleaner helps identify profiles for review and submit confirmed suppressions to Klaviyo.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion1: How does the app connect with Klaviyo?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer1: The app uses Klaviyo OAuth. You do not need to paste a private API key, and you can disconnect the account from the app settings.
BotCleaner.faqAnswer2: It audits profiles that already exist in the authorized Klaviyo account. It does not block forms or checkouts before a profile is created.
BotCleaner.faqAnswer3: It uses explainable profile-level signals such as disposable-domain matches, unusual email patterns, generic or incomplete profile data, repeated values, high-volume creation windows, and available subscription metadata. A result is a review signal, not absolute proof.
BotCleaner.pricingDesc: Choose a plan based on the number of scans, profiles, and suppressions your store needs.
BotCleaner.ctaTitle: Review suspicious profiles with more control.
BotCleaner.ctaDesc: Check availability and learn how the OAuth audit, review, and suppression workflow fits your store.
BotCleaner.tutorialDesc: Connect through OAuth, run a background audit, review the signals, select profiles, and confirm any suppressions you want to submit.
BotCleaner.tStep1Desc: Authorize the app through Klaviyo OAuth. The app does not ask you to paste a private API key.
BotCleaner.tStep2Desc: Start a background scan of existing Klaviyo profiles.
BotCleaner.tStep3Desc: See the risk score, risk category, and human-readable reasons.
BotCleaner.tStep4Desc: Select the profiles you want to act on. No destructive action runs automatically.
BotCleaner.tStep5Desc: Confirm the action and submit selected profiles to Klaviyo suppression in batches. Suppression prevents marketing sends; it is not permanent profile deletion.
BotCleaner.doesNotTitle: What Bot Cleaner does not do
BotCleaner.doesNot1: It does not block Shopify checkouts.
BotCleaner.doesNot2: It does not block signup forms before profiles reach Klaviyo.
BotCleaner.doesNot3: It does not edit Liquid or theme files.
BotCleaner.doesNot4: It does not apply Shopify customer tags.
BotCleaner.doesNot5: It does not permanently delete profiles in the current version.
BotCleaner.doesNot6: It does not prove that every flagged profile is a bot.
BotCleaner.doesNot7: It does not guarantee a lower Klaviyo invoice.
BotCleaner.doesNot8: It does not replace SPF, DKIM, or DMARC configuration.
BotCleaner.savingsNote: Any savings shown are estimates. They may not change your Klaviyo invoice unless your account crosses a billing threshold.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion4: Does the app block real customers?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer4: No. It does not block customers, checkouts, or forms. Suppression only happens after the merchant selects profiles and confirms the action.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion5: Does suppression permanently delete a profile?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer5: No. The current version uses Klaviyo suppression to prevent marketing sends. It does not implement permanent deletion.
BotCleaner.faqAnswer6: No. It shows an estimate based on configurable assumptions. The actual result depends on Klaviyo billing level, message volume, country, SMS usage, and account thresholds.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion7: Do I need to modify my theme?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer7: No. The app operates from Shopify Admin and backend APIs. It does not require Liquid files or storefront scripts.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion8: Does the app configure SPF, DKIM, or DMARC?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer8: No. Domain authentication must be configured separately using Klaviyo's instructions and your DNS provider.
